set.body:
PRD A-11, IO-6. Release court for EyeLink support under epic bd-01M039NWZN0BNEDYHVXZFB29CQ. Binary EDF remains out of scope; vendor EDF2ASC is the required conversion boundary.

Acceptance criteria:
- At least one licensed real EDF-derived ASC per validated critical layout reaches raw session, validated Recording or BinocularRecording, native-event evidence, ObservedTimeline, synchronization evidence where marks exist, and a downstream scanpath.
- Parsed canonical manifests agree with independent EDF Access API and available vendor ASC reference manifests under named field-specific tolerances.
- Corpus coverage includes the published support matrix; absent cells are explicitly unvalidated.
- Conversion provenance binds EDF digest when permitted, ASC digest, converter executable/version identity, exact options, platform, and failsafe state.
- Line/sample/event/message/block counts reconcile and rejected or unknown records remain visible.
- JVM and Scala.js canonical digests agree; required mutants fail; streaming memory and throughput evidence meet declared budgets.
- A clean, release-bound EyeLink validation artifact and task-first guide are published and verified in hosted CI.
